interests.fieldLabel: Add an interest in your own words
interests.thirdPartyWarning: Added. Please only add interests about yourself.
interests.limit: You have reached 20 interests. Remove one to add another.
interests.starLimit: You can star up to 3 interests.
interests.didYouMean: Did you mean {{label}} by “{{typed}}”? Saying yes puts you with more people.
interests.tapToChange: Tap an interest to change whether it's private.
interests.nudge: Add at least 3. 5 or more gives better pods.
interests.madeOrdinary: Done. We now treat this as an ordinary interest, for you only.
interests.removeWithdrawNamed: Remove {{name}} and withdraw consent for it
interests.privateExplainer: Only used to form pods about this interest. Never on a profile, never in a notification.
interests.privateOff: Off. You haven't agreed to sensitive interests, so we don't save interests that may be sensitive.
interests.optionsOrdinary: Does “{{name}}” say something sensitive about you? Keep it private and it's only used as a pod's theme.
interests.optionsLocked: “{{name}}” is private and only used as a pod's theme. If it isn't sensitive for you, make it an ordinary interest.

model.preparing: Getting interests ready on your phone…
model.notBundled: This version of the app doesn't include what your phone needs to understand interests. Install the app from the App Store or Google Play.
model.storage: Your phone needs about 260 MB of free space to get interests ready, once. Free up some space, then try again.
model.integrity: Something went wrong getting interests ready, so we deleted it. Please try again. If it keeps happening, reinstall the app.
model.runtime: This phone can't run the interest check right now (it may need more free memory). Close other apps and try again.
model.notPinned: Adding interests isn't available in this version yet.

moderation.TAG_TOO_SHORT: An interest needs at least 2 characters.
moderation.TAG_TOO_LONG: An interest can have at most 40 characters.
moderation.PII: Interests cannot contain contact details such as phone numbers, emails, links or handles.
moderation.BLOCKLIST: This interest isn't allowed on Grouper.
moderation.THIRD_PARTY_SENSITIVE: This seems to describe someone else's sensitive situation. Describe your own instead, for example “parent of an autistic child”.
moderation.SENSITIVE_ADD_LIMIT: You can add at most 3 sensitive interests per week.
moderation.SENSITIVE_UNAVAILABLE: Sensitive interests can't be added yet.
moderation.ART9_CONSENT_REQUIRED: This interest may be sensitive, so we only save it if you've agreed to sensitive interests. Nothing was sent or saved. You can give consent in Settings → Privacy.
moderation.ART9_CONSENT_REQUIRED_SERVER: This interest may be sensitive, so we only save it if you've agreed to sensitive interests. We didn't save it. You can give consent in Settings → Privacy.

privacy.title: Privacy
privacy.privateOff: Not given, so nothing sensitive is saved
privacy.sameGenderWithdraw: Turn off and delete my gender
privacy.pauseDetail: Skip drops until you come back
privacy.exportDetail: A file you can keep, ready within minutes
privacy.complaint: Unhappy with how we handle your data? You can complain to the Danish Data Protection Agency (datatilsynet.dk).

deleteAccount.title: Delete your account?
deleteAccount.lede: This can't be undone. If you just need a break, you can pause matching instead.
deleteAccount.deletedNow: Your profile, interests, private interests, photo and votes are deleted now.
deleteAccount.leavePods: You leave every pod. The others only see “A member left”.
deleteAccount.backups: Copies in our backups disappear within 7 days.
deleteAccount.signInRecord: Your sign-in record at Google's login service can take up to 180 days to clear.
deleteAccount.keptRecords: A few records we must keep, such as proof of consent and reports, are kept without your name.
deleteAccount.reauthNote: To keep your account safe, we'll ask you to sign in again first.
deleteAccount.confirmBody: Next, you sign in again to confirm it's you. Then your account is deleted.
